lines.trans: Goodbye, Camille, thank you for everything.
The party was really nice here.
Thank you for coming tonight, Sarah.
There you are at last, is everything okay?
There is a party in Saint-Ouen.
What is the big rush now?
This party is going to be incredible.
My friends are waiting for us there.
Did you arrange good transportation?
Yes, a taxi is waiting outside.
All right, let's leave right away.
Perfect, we are going there together.
Come on, come with me, Sarah!
Have a very good night!

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?
polite and neutral; salut is more casual

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: as a masculine noun: pour le bien de = for the good of
as an interjection: bon, alors... = right, so...

meanings.en: bonne journée = have a nice day

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.en: as a noun: the whole, a set

examples.text: On fait la fête ce soir!
Il y a une autre Clémentine?

meanings.note: il y a trois semaines = three weeks ago

examples.trans: You came! I can't believe it!

meanings.note: c'est incroyable! = I can't believe it! / it's amazing!
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Donc je veux vraiment tourner là-bas.
examples.trans: So I really want to shoot over there.

meanings.note: merci beaucoup = thank you very much
no object: je pars = I'm leaving
partir en vacances = to go on holiday

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

meanings.en: to plan, to anticipate, to foresee

examples.trans: How old would you say she is?

examples.text: Je ne peux pas venir ce soir.

meanings.note: bonne soirée = have a nice evening

examples.text: Ce serait super si vous pouviez venir.
examples.trans: It would be great if you could come.

meanings.note: prendre un taxi / monter dans le taxi

examples.trans: We're going to call a taxi.

meanings.note: before the verb; t' before a vowel

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
c'est une urgence = it's an emergency
venir de: je viens de la Côte d'Azur
venir de + infinitive: je viens d'arriver = I've just arrived

voilà.gloss: there is; here's; there you go

meanings.note: il y a = there is / there are
j'y pense = I think about it
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
